applied.problem: IEEE 43's 5000 MΩ limit applies to the 1-minute reading corrected to 40 °C; L3's 23.0 GΩ is read at 12 °C (about 3.3 GΩ at 40 °C by the halving rule), so 'far above 5000 MΩ… above that' misstates it. Screen 4 also says DAR readings are minutes apart; they are 30 s apart.

The DAR's two readings are 30 s apart, not minutes apart, which the lesson itself says elsewhere; and a ratio near 1 is only a pointer, since some insulation materials show very little absorption even when sound.
